assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The payer letter acknowledges medical necessity and coverage eligibility for CPT 93229 depend on the clinical indication
The clinical indication is documented as symptomatic dizziness and giddiness requiring telemetry to identify contributing arrhythmias or ischemic changes
